summary: A birth and a death in the family are put in the same plain tone as the crop notes.

sources: Kansas Historical Quarterly, A Hoosier in Kansas: the diary of Hiram H. Young, 1890 to 1891: https://www.kansashistory.gov/p/kansas-historical-quarterly-a-hoosier-in-kansas-2/13032
